column3: ambhodhiḥ sthalatāṃ sthalaṃ jaladhitāṃ dhūler lavaṃ śailatām |
śailo mṛtkaṇatāṃ tṛṇaṃ dahanatāṃ vajraṃ tṛṇakṣīṇatām |
vahniḥ śītalatāṃ himaṃ dahanatām āyāti yasyecchayā |
līlānāṭyakṛte bhuvo bhagavate kṛṣṇāya tubhyaṃ namaḥ |
pathyāpathyam atho vipākam akhilaṃ tāvan nṛṇāṃ karmaṇaḥ ||
gadasya sāmānyaviśeṣatattvair yuktāni kurve kati lakṣaṇāni ||
śabdārthāvagame bhajanti sakalā devā sadā mūkatāṃ manye kiṃtu viśanti pāram paraṃ duṣpāraśāstrāmbudheḥ |
kartuṃ yady api śakyate laghutayā sāraś cikitsārṇavo doṣo jātu bhaviṣyatīti manasā nyūnādhiko na kṛtaḥ ||
cintāmaṇeḥ prathamataḥ kiraṇaiś caturbhiḥ dravyasya mānam akhilasya rasasya śuddhiḥ |
kālāditattvakathanaṃ tv atha nāḍikādes tattvaṃ tato .nyakiraṇair upacāraṇāya ||
śāstreṣu śramavān kriyāsu kuśalaḥ prājñaḥ sudhīḥ satyavāk dhīro roganirūpaṇaikakuśalaḥ pīyūṣahastaḥ śuciḥ |
dravyāṇāṃ rasavīryakāryam akhilaṃ jñātā dayāluḥ sadā nirṇetā ṛtukāladeśavayasāṃ mātrādhikārī bhiṣak ||
kṛṣṇarekhāṅkuro yas tu dagdhahastaḥ sa ucyate ||
avijñāya tu śāstrārthaṃ prayogaṃ kārayed bhiṣak |
vinā śāstro yo brūyāt tam āhuḥ brahmaghātakaḥ |
naro narakapātī syāt tasya sambhāṣaṇād api ||
na jānāti ca śāstrāṇi lakṣaṇaṃ yo na vidyate |
mārayaty āśu jantūnāṃ sa vaidyo yamakiṃkaraḥ ||
eko netra rujāvabhakṣitatanu kṛṣṭī bhavet ślīpadī ||
vaidyaṃ rasam auṣadham anahitaṃ rogī akāle mriyaḥ ||
etad vaidyasya vaidyatvaṃ na vaidyaḥ prabhur āyuṣaḥ ||
kucelaḥ karkaśo lubdhaḥ kugrāmī svayam āgataḥ |
pañca vaidyā na pūjyante dhanvantarisamā yadi ||
na mānena vinā yuktir dravyāṇāṃ jāyate kvacit |
tataḥ prāhus trasareṇu tatra ṣaḍbhir ājāhvayā sarṣapaḥ ||
syād ebhis tribhir eva toḍitatanu gaurāhvayaḥ sarṣapaḥ ṣaḍbhis taiś ca yavo bhaved atha yavair etais tribhī raktikā |
guñjaḥ syāt triyavaiś ca raktiyugalaṃ vallaś ca tatpañcakair māṣomāṣacatuṣṭyam nigaditaṃ śāṇaś ca śānadvayam ||
kolaṃ draṃkṣaṇakaṃ tathaiva vaṭakaṃ koladvayaṃ karṣakaṃ cākṣaḥ pāṇitalaṃ viḍālapadakaṃ tadvat suvarṇaṃ picuḥ |
karṣābhyām api śuktikā nigaditā karṣaiś caturbhiḥ palam bilvaṃ muṣṭir athāpi śuktiyugalaṃ syāt kuñcikā ṣoḍaśī ||
bilve dve .pi mānika ca prasṛtaṃ nāmnā caturbhiḥ palaiḥ yuktaḥ syāt kuḍavo .ñjaliś ca palikāny aṣṭau śarāvo bhavet |
tanmānaṃ dharaṇaṃ palasya daśamo bhāgo bhavet yatsthitaṃ vidyāc cāpi śataṃ palāni ca tulā bhāras tulāviṃśatiḥ ||
prasthaḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ palair atha catuḥ prasthaṃ bhaved āḍhakaṃ kaṃsaḥ pātram athāḍhakāni ca punaś catvāri saṃjāyate |
droṇoralvaṇavyarmaṇaṃ ca kalaśo droṇadvayaṃ syāt punaḥ sūrpaḥ kumbham ihollikhanti ca catuḥṣaṣṭiḥ śarābā śubhāḥ ||
droṇī droṇacatuṣṭayena tulikā tasyāḥ śarāvāḥ śatam aṣṭaviṃśatisaṃyutaṃ ca bharikā syur mānasaṃpratyaye |
māṣaḥ śāṇapicuḥ palaṃ ca kuḍavaḥ prasthas tathā cāḍhako droṇo goṇyapitāś caturguṇatayā nirdhāritāḥ syuḥ kramāt ||
yavaḥ syāt sarṣapaiḥ ṣaḍbhir guñjā tu syāt tribhir yavaiḥ |
bhavet ṣoḍaśabhir māṣaiḥ suvarṇas tat punaḥ smṛtaḥ |
caturbhiḥ palam etasya daśamo dharaṇo viduḥ |

column5: palaṃ suvarṇāś catvāraḥ palāni dharaṇaṃ daśa |

column3: śuṣkaṃ navīnaṃ sakaleṣu yojyam dravyaṃ tathārdraṃ dviguṇaṃ prayojyam |
śuṣkasya tāvad guru tīkṣṇasattvāt tadarddhabhāgaḥ parikalpanīyaḥ ||
palaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ prasthaḥ śuṣkāṇāṃ ca tato viduḥ |
dvātriṃśatpalakaṃ tadarddham uditaṃ prasthaṃ rasaṃ cauṣadham ||
kṣaudraṃ tailaghṛte ca viṃśatipalaṃ kṣīrasya triṃśatpalam |
mūlatvak dārupattrāṇāṃ puṣpasya ca phalasya ca |
vinā viḍaṅgakṛṣṇābhyāṃ guḍadhānyājyamakṣikaiḥ guḍūcī kuṭajo vāsā kuṣmāṇḍaś ca śatāvarī |
vāsā nimbapaṭolaketakībalā kuṣmāṇḍakendīvarī varṣābhūkuṭajāśvagandhasahitās tāḥ pūtigandhāmṛtāḥ |
māṃsaṃ nāgabalā sahacarapūgahiṅgvārdrake nityaśo grāhyas tat pala eva na dviguṇitāṃ ye cekṣujātāghanāḥ ||
ekasya cauṣadher yogo yat tatra punar ucyate |
dravyābhāve dravyam anyad dviguṇaṃ vihitaṃ hitam |
yogayuktaṃ yadā prāpyaṃ yuktitulyaṃ ca nikṣipet ||
sāras tu khadirādīnāṃ nimbādīnāṃ tvacaṃ tathā |
phalaṃ tu dāḍimādīnāṃ paṭolādeś chadas tathā ||
sitābhāve bhavet khaṇḍaḥ śālyabhāve ca ṣaṣṭikam ||
drave .py anukte jalam atra deyaṃ kāle .py anukte divasasya pūrvam |
bhāge .py anukte samatā vidhānam .ṅge .py anukte vihitaṃ tu mūlam ||
cūrṇe snehe tathā lehe prāyaś candanāni ca |
lavaṇe saindhavaṃ dadyān mūtre gomūtram iṣyate |
viśeṣo yatra noktaḥ syād eṣas tatra vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ||
karṣādau tu palaṃ yāvad dadyāt ṣoḍaśikaṃ jalam ||
tatas tu kuḍavo yāvat toyam aṣṭaguṇaṃ bhavet |
draveṇa yāvad vā dravyam ekībhūyārdratāṃ vrajet |
jātā vidhināpihṛtā auṣadhyaḥ siddhidā na syuḥ ||
nyūnaṃ samadhikaṃ dravyaṃ na siddhidam iti jalpur bhiṣajaḥ ||
mūlaṃ trivarṣaṃ bījaṃ tu syāt saṃvatsarapañcakam |
niryāso daśamaṃ varṣaṃ tadūrdhvaṃ na praśasyate ||
lehaṃ pāṇiṃ talaṃ tathaiva guṭikā cākṣapramāṇaṃ rajaḥ |
randhre pūrṇatamaṃ ca karṇayugale gaṇḍūṣamāsye rasaḥ ||
kaṣāyaḥ palaṃmātraṃ syād iti bhojamatam viduḥ ||
yāmaṃ kalkaṃ kaṣāyavīryam akhilaṃ cūrṇaṃ ca pakṣatrayaṃ ṣaṇmāsaṃ ghṛtalehayo sapurayor māsatrayaṃ modakaḥ |
siddhānāṃ rasabhasmanāṃ suvipulaṃ vīryaṃ ca varṣatrayaṃ kiṃcid gandhavivarjitaṃ guṇakaraṃ tailaṃ purāṇaṃ mahat ||
kvāthaś ca kalkaś ca rasaś ca yāmaṃ yāmatrayaṃ modakavarticūrṇam |
ṣaṇmāsalehyaṃ ghṛtaguggulubhyām abdāt paraṃ tailakṛtaṃ ca vīryam ||
śītaṃ jalaṃ jīryati yāmamātre yāmārdhake jīryati taptatoyam |
kalkaś ca cūrṇaṃ ca ghaṭī tṛtīye kaṣāyakaṃ jīryati yāmamātre ||
yāmadvaye tu svarasā vasāś ca jīryanti te saptaghaṭīṣu sadyaḥ |
jīryanti lehyāny api pañcaghaṭyāṃ yāmatraye jīryati dugdhajātam ||
yāmadvaye jīryati vā ghṛtānnaṃ piṣṭaṃ tathā jīryati pañcayāme |
sārddhe triyāmā dadhi śuktam annaṃ māṃsaṃ tathā jīryati tāvad eva ||
annaṃ tadā jīryati pañcarātre kṣīraṃ tathā saptaniśīthinīṣu |
khanetrarātrau dadhi jīrṇamāse māsārdhike jīryati dugdhasāram ||
ghṛtaṃ gate māsi sujīrṇam āste māsadvaye jīryati māṃsam eva ca |
dvibhāgaṃ pūrayed annaṃ toyaṃ bhāgaṃ prapūrayet |
athātaḥ svarasaḥ kalkaḥ kvāthaś ca himaphāṇṭakau |
vastraniṣpīḍitaṃ yat tu cūrṇitaṃ dviguṇe jale |
ahorātraṃ sthitaṃ vāpi svaraso dvividho mataḥ ||
ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ ca cūrṇādi kolamātraṃ rase kṣipet ||
dravyam ādyaṃ śilāpiṣṭaṃ śuṣkaṃ vā sajalaṃ bhavet |
sitā guḍaṃ samaṃ dadyāt dravād deyāś caturguṇāḥ ||
śṛtaṃ tad dvipalaṃ grāhyaṃ kvātho niryūha ucyate ||
kṣuṇṇaṃ dravyaṃ palaṃ samyak ṣaḍbhir nīrapalaiḥ plutam |
viśoṣitaṃ himaḥ sa syāt tathā śītakaṣāyakaḥ ||
kṣiptvā niṣpīḍya vastreṇa taddravo pāṇṭha ucyate ||
vāriprasthe ca vipacet taddravo yūṣa ucyate ||
mṛtpātre manthayet samyak mantha ity abhidhīyate ||
kvāthaṃ caturguṇaṃ vāri kalkam aṣṭaguṇaṃ tathā |
kaṣāyaṃ ca daśaguṇaṃ pācanaṃ dvādaśam bhavet ||
śuṣkaṃ piṣṭaṃ vastrapūtaṃ cūrṇaṃ tat parikīrtitam |
annaṃ pañcaguṇe sādhyaṃ vilepī tu caturguṇe |
palaṃ kaṣāye dravaṃ syāt yavāgvāṃ ca tadardhakam |
pānīyeṣu tadarddhaṃ syād iti dravyasya niścayaḥ ||
kvāthyamānaṃ tu yat toyaṃ niṣphenaṃ nirmalīkṛtam |
bhavaty ardhāvaśiṣṭaṃ ca tad uṣṇodakam ucyate ||
dravyād aṣṭaguṇaṃ kṣīraṃ kṣīrāt toyaṃ caturguṇam |
madhu śeṣe bhaved yāvat tāvat paktvāvatārayet ||
palāny aṣṭau śodhitārdrāt palaṃ ṣoḍaśakaṃ tathā ||
śoṣaṇaṃ cāpi saṃskāro viśeṣaś cātra kathyate ||

column3: tadvad āmalakam amlam uttamaṃ śītavīryaṃ kaphapittanāśanam |
keśyam akṣogadaghātīśītalaṃ vṛṣyam āśu vinihanti ṣaṇḍatām ||
maricaṃ laghu tiktarasaṃ kaṭukaṃ ghāti ca hṛdrogasaṃśamanam |
śuṇṭhī snigdhā śothaśūlānilaghnī coṣṇā kaṭvī śleṣmadoṣān nihanti |
madhuraṃ malinahṛt syāt tiktam īṣat kaṭūṣṇam |
nāgakeśaram atīva śītalaṃ pittadāhaśamanaṃ ca tiktakam |
jīrakaḥ kaṭur udīrito himo dīpanaṃ kṛmiharo .rśasāṃ hitaḥ |
śītapittaharaḥ karoti na kapha,ṛṣṭo nidāghe hito |
dagdhāṅge śiśire ca pīnasagare pathyo .lpa uṣṇaḥ kaṭuḥ ||
ity evaṃ kathitāś caturdaśa guṇāḥ kastūrikāyāḥ punaḥ ||
yā gandhaḥ ketakīnāṃ harati parimalair varṇataḥ piṅgalābhā |
svāde tiktā kaṭvī laghur atha tulitā marditā cikkaṇā syāt ||
kṣiptāgnau bhasma na syāc cimicimi kurute carmagandhā hutāśe |
sā śuddhā śobhanāsyā varamṛgatanujā rājayogyā prasiddhā ||
karatalajalamadhye sthāpayitvā muhūrtaṃ punar api yadi paśyed daṇḍamātraṃ nirīkṣya |
yadi bhavati ca raktaṃ tajjalaṃ pītavarṇaṃ na bhavati mṛganābhiḥ kṛtrimo .sau vikāraḥ ||
ūrdhvaṃ śūlaviṣadoṣaharaṃ tadrocanaṃ tu tanukāntikaraṃ ca ||
sauvarcalaṃ saindhavaṃ ca viḍam audbhidam eva ca |
sāmudreṇa sahaitāni pañca syur lavaṇāni ca |
teṣu mukhyaṃ saindhavaṃ syāt sarvabhāveṣu kṣepayet ||
sindhūdbhavaṃ netrarujāpahaṃ ca saṃdīpanīyaṃ rucivṛṣyam uktam |
pūtaṃ tridoṣopaśamaṃ karoti viḍbandhanaṃ svādurasaṃ vraṇaghnam ||
medaś cāpi mahāmedo jīvantī madhukaṃ tathā ||
dvau medau dvau ca kākolyau jīvakarṣabhakau tathā |
ṛddhyabhāve balā grāhyā vṛddhau tv atibalā tathā ||
saṃsarge tat samoṣṇaṃ syāt sannipāte tv aśītalam ||
rātrau śītāṃśukiraṇair dhātūn puṣyanti te malāḥ ||
tṛṣite gaṇḍūṣatoyasya pāne kvātheṣv ayaṃ kramaḥ ||
antaḥ sunīlo bahir ujjvalo yo madhyāhnasūryapratimaprakāśaḥ |
śasto .tha dhūmraḥ paripāṇḍuraś ca sūto na yojyo rasakarmasiddhau ||
pātayet pātanayantre samyak śuddho raso bhavet ||

column3: atyagniś cāṣṭadoṣāś ca nisargāt pārade sthitāḥ ||
saurṇai niśeṣṭakā dhūmra jambīrāmbubhir ā dinam |
marditaḥ kāṃjikair dhauto nāgadoṣaṃ rasas tyajet ||

svarṇe sahasraṃ gagane śatekaṃ vajre guṇākoṭiś cānanta sūte ||
